ph: Swamishri performing the Murti Pratishtha of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj 31 Oct, 99

w: In the morning, the Defense Minister of India, Shri George Fernandes, arrived for Swamishri's darshan and blessings.

In the evening assembly, kishores performed a welcome dance and a drama, 'Valueless Education.' Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly emphasizing the need for parents and teachers to impart values of honesty, endeavor, spiritual faith, morality, etc.
When one wants to go to Akshardham, should one have lesser thoughts? If one has a higher thought then smaller thoughts dissolve away. (20 Oct 02)
Laziness is to think that 'I will do this after a minute, after an hour.' (21 Oct 02)

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
21 Oct 2002, Gondal
7 devotees cycled 200 km from Kodinar to Gondal. 15 youths pilgrimage by foot from Rajkot to Gondal (28 km).
At 9.30 a.m. Swamishri performed the foundation-stone laying ceremony of an assembly hall in the mandir ground.
After his morning puja Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of murtis for BAPS hari mandirs in Bhesan and Budhel in Bhavnagar district.

3 November 2008, Gondal; Labh Pancham Prior to his morning puja Swamishri blessed the large family of the late Daji Bapu. Altogether, 42 members, from 7 years to 76 years, had pilgrimaged by foot from Rajkot to Gondal. After his morning puja Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of the Nilkanth Varni abhishek murti to be consecrated at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir in Rajkot. Swamishri inaugurated the decennial celebration of Rajkot mandir by waving the BAPS flag. During the last five days a parayan was sponsored by Shri Chhotubhai Ajmera. Every morning Brahmadarshan Swami explained the Vachanamrut and in the evenings Viveksagar Swami elaborated upon the Bhaktachintamani. Today was the concluding day of the parayan . Swamishri blessed the evening assembly, “Gondal is a great tirtha like Akshardham. Shriji Maharaj and Gunatitanand Swami are divinely present in Akshar Deri. Yogiji Maharaj had said, ‘Maharaj will bless one with liberation for whatever good deeds one performs here. This is the glory of Akshar Deri.’ Bhaktachintamani contains the divine incidents of Maharaj. It describes how God sat, ate, bathed, met others, brought joy to them and played raas . It may all seem ordinary to us, but the devotees perceived them with divine glory. All actions of God blesses one with moksha. ”

After narrating the story of Gajendra Moksha (the liberation of the elephant king), Sevanishth Swami said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Just as he protected the elephant from the crocodile, you too must protect us."
Swamishri said, "Keep talking like this, and it will happen. Firmness comes only through such talks. When we tell others, it becomes firm in us."
Sevanishth Swami said, "You give your word that you will protect us, don't you?"
Swamishri said, "Since we have become God's, God will certainly protect us; Jogibapa will protect us. Keep faith and trust; it may be sooner or later, but he will do it."
A sadhu said, "Please give your word. We will keep faith and trust. We will do arti, our disciplines, katha and talks, everything regularly."
Swamishri said, "Since we have come into God's refuge, God will certainly protect us."
Sevanishth Swami said, "We are in your refuge."

Swamishri said, "If we do it (seva and taking refuge) with true feeling, it will certainly happen. Keep faith and trust that the work will certainly be done. Shriji Maharaj is supreme. We have found gurus like Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, so the work is bound to be done."

Having said this, Swamishri went on, "Just as he gave up all other supports and took refuge in God alone, so if there is only one support, if the others go out of our soul, if it becomes 'You are my only support...', then the work is done."
Sevanishth Swami said, "For us, you are our only support."

Swamishri immediately said, "Our support is God. So and so will do my work, and such and such will do my work, no one; God alone is the one who does it. If that becomes firm, there will be no problem."
After presenting the story of Gajendra Moksha, Sevanishtha Swami said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Just as the elephant was protected from the crocodile, you too must protect us."
Swamishri said, "Keep on talking about such things, and it will happen. Firmness comes from talks alone. When we tell others, it becomes firm in us."
Sevanishtha Swami said, "You give your word, don't you, that you will protect us?"
Swamishri said, "We have become Bhagwan's, so Bhagwan will certainly protect us, Jogi Bapa will protect us. Keep faith and trust. It may be sooner or later, but he will do it."
One sant said, "Please give your word. We will keep faith and trust. We will do the arti, our niyams (spiritual disciplines) and katha regularly."
Swamishri said, "We have come to the refuge of Bhagwan, so Bhagwan will certainly protect us."
Sevanishtha Swami said, "We are in your refuge."

Swamishri said, "If we do it (seva and taking refuge) with true feeling, it will certainly happen. Keep faith and trust that the work will certainly be done. Shriji Maharaj is supreme. We have found gurus like Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, so the work is bound to be done."

After saying this, Swamishri added, "Just as he (the elephant) gave up every other support and took the refuge of Bhagwan alone, if we have only one support, if everything else leaves our soul, if it becomes 'Mohe to tum ek adhara...' (You are my only support), then the work is done."
Sevanishtha Swami said, "We have only your support."

Swamishri immediately said, "We have the support of Bhagwan. So-and-so will do my work, such-and-such will do my work, no, none of them. Bhagwan alone is the one who does it. If this becomes firm, there will be no problem."

Today, on New Year's Day, after the morning puja, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was entering his residence from the dining room side, Amrutvallabhdas Swami asked, "What did Ghanshyam Maharaj tell you today on New Year's Day?"
"He says the same thing every day: a sense of divinity!"
Swamishri told us his daily message.
